description: Single and two storey side to rear extension to create new dwelling house with rear dormer and roof lights in front roof slope; Private amenity space; Landscaping; Boundary treatment; Parking; Cycle and refuse storage; Single and two storey rear extension; Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front roof slope; External alterations
decision_conditions: <p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The&nbsp;</span>proposed two storey side extension, together with the proposed gable end roof and large double rear dormer, and the intersection created between these aspects of the proposal, would result in an inappropriate roof form which is considered a bulky, unduly obtrusive and incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse which would fail to respect the character and proportions of the dwellinghouse and the visual amenities of the locality and therefore would be contrary to the high quality design aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy D3 (D.1 and D.11) of The London Plan (2021), Policies GR1 of the Harrow Local Plan (2021-2041) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).</p><br data-cke-eol="1">

<p><span style="line-height: 115%;">The proposed
development is located within surface water </span><span lang="EN-US" style="line-height: 115%;">flood zones high and medium plus within fluvial
flood zone 2</span><span style="line-height: 115%;">.
In the absence of a satisfactory Flood Risk Assessment, it has not been
demonstrated that the proposed development would not exacerbate the risk of
flooding within the site or increase the risk and consequences of flooding
elsewhere, contrary to National Planning Policy Framework (2026), Policy SI 12
of The London Plan (2021)and Policies CN3 and CN4 of the Harrow Local Plan
(2021-2041).</span></p>
